caroline.description: Music player: plays a file, a folder or a playlist from the SD card; pause, skip, seek

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: What plays now: the track, the time, the place in the queue, the order

tools.name: play
tools.description: Plays a file (with the rest of its folder after it), a folder (with its subfolders) or a playlist (.m3u) of the SD card

tools.name: previous
tools.description: The previous track, or the start of this one

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stops and goes back to the start of the track

tools.name: seek
tools.description: Moves within the track by this many seconds (negative: back)
